newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombia H1 retail sales off 2.67 pct, cars slide.
newsitem.headline: Colombia H1 retail sales off 2.67 pct, cars slide.

text.p: Retail sales in Colombia's leading cities fell 2.67 percent in the first half compared to the same period of 1995, the National Statistics Department (DANE) said.
But excluding car and truck sales, the fall was just 0.14 percent, however. Car and truck sales plummeted 18.96 percent, compared to a 0.88 percent drop in the first half of 1995.
The drop comes against the backdrop of a sharp slowdown in economic growth so far this year.

In a sign of possible hope for a rebound in the second half, DANE said retail sales, excluding oil derivatives and gasoline, were up 1.66 in June over the same month last year. Excluding vehicles as well as fuel, June posted a robust 3.70 increase in retail sales, it said.
Furniture and household electric appliances goods were hardest hit by the slump in sales between January and June, plunging 21.52 percent from the level seen in January-June 1995.
